chunks: With this chain of transmission, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Zurārah, from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Hishām ibn Sālim, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, concerning:
A man approaching a woman in what is short of the private part while she is menstruating. He عليه السلام said: There is no harm, if he avoids that place.

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةَ: the woman or wife in this legal context
key_terms.الْمَوْضِعَ: the specific place meant here, i.e. the place to be avoided
key_terms.حَائِضٌ: a woman in the state of menstruation
key_terms.دُونَ الْفَرْجِ: other than the vaginal area; short of intercourse
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or legal objection

ai.seo_question: What is permissible for a man with his wife when she is menstruating according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling regarding intimacy with a menstruating wife. It states that there is no objection to forms of intimacy short of intercourse, provided the place of bleeding is avoided.
